src/check.mts.reason: Not statements: the raw-statement scanner's own comments and patterns name the forms it counts.

src/db.mts.reason: transaction() sends BEGIN, COMMIT and ROLLBACK on its checked-out connection so it can release or discard it; Drizzle has no builder for transaction control.

src/migration-ledger.mts.reason: The migration ledger applies migration files as SQL text and takes its advisory locks and schema_version rows on a pg client before any app schema exists.

src/tenancy.mts.reason: The policy expression is DDL, which takes no bind parameters; set_config and current_setting have no Drizzle builder; the boot role check reads system catalogues on a pg pool.

src/workspace-team.mts.reason: The team controller predates the Drizzle team tables; part two of the framework moves it to typed Drizzle queries and lowers this entry.
